strategy.note: basis: Tab. 11.5 'Unit process inventory of the dataset "electronic component, passive, unspecified, at plant (GLO)"', per 1 kg; the shares come from Tab. 11.3 (average composition of the printed wiring boards of a television, a desktop computer and a laptop).; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2007 - LCI electric and electronic equipment - Hischier.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: The report has no washing-machine-specific passive-component dataset; this is the generic GLO mix, so the BAFU dataset's composition may differ.
The dataset is a pure assembly of component datasets: no energy, no transport, no infrastructure and no direct emissions of its own.
The eight shares sum to 1.0003 kg per kg, i.e. the table is normalised to 1 kg of components.
Uncertainty is explicitly 'rather high' (StDv95 = 2.29 on every line).
